name: Félix Vallotton

summary.text: Félix Édouard Vallotton was a Swiss and French painter and printmaker associated with the group of artists known as Les Nabis. He was an important figure in the development of the modern woodcut.

47517342: The Red Room is an 1898 tempera-on-cardboard painting by Swiss artist Félix Vallotton. It depicts a red interior and a couple standing in a dark doorway.
97860806: Naked Woman Sleeping by the Water is an oil on canvas painting by the Swiss and French artist Félix Vallotton, from 1926. It was given to the Strasbourg museum by Vallotton's widow in 1926 and is now in the Strasbourg Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art.
